listNote: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation published the list on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, 28 of them hidden until earned. Every trophy can be earned offline in a single playthrough; the game has no mission replay, which is what makes the four flagged trophies missable.

raritySnapshot.label: Launch snapshot — Exophase, read 2026-11-19, 638 players tracked
raritySnapshot.note: Rarity is the percent of the players Exophase tracked for the game who had earned the trophy when the snapshot was read on launch night. It is a launch snapshot, not a live figure: every rate will drift as more players finish the game.

roadmap.blurb: The prologue and Chapter 1. Learn the controls, finish Gone Fishing and Breakfast Run, and pick up the two cheap one-off trophies sitting on the opening route before the map pulls you inland.
roadmap.title: Touchdown in Leonida

roadmap.blurb: Chapters 2 and 3. The crew's operations open up: sample every activity type once, beat Cal at fishing, meet Bret, and keep a scoped rifle handy for your first Combat Focus sweep.
roadmap.title: Making a Name

roadmap.blurb: Chapter 4 and the late missions. Save manually before VCIA Takedown — its airfield finale holds a missable — then close out the stranger strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
roadmap.title: Empire Business

roadmap.blurb: The finale and the choice-driven missables. Keep rotating saves through the last chapters so the partner beats can be revisited, then celebrate with the two partner free-roam feats.
roadmap.title: Endgame and Choices

roadmap.blurb: Post-story free roam. Everything left is a count, a sweep or a one-off feat: stunts, range golds, races, cards, meditation spots, vaults, gangs, garages and the two money grinds, region by region.
roadmap.title: The Leonida Completionist

roadmap.blurb: The 100 percent checklist and the platinum it feeds. When the checklist reads 100, A Long Road lands — and with every other trophy in, Vice Got a Price! follows on its own.
roadmap.title: The Long Road

sources.name: PlayStation — official trophy list
sources.note: The 55 names, descriptions and grades exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every requirement quoted in this guide traces back to this list.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy page
sources.note: Source of the launch rarity snapshot used throughout the app (read 2026-11-19, 638 players tracked) and an independent copy of the official list, used to cross-check every name, description and grade.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and count tracking
sources.note: Cross-check of the official list and of the totals PlayStation tracks for the counted trophies — 250 stunts, 42 range golds, 500 choices, the two money totals — which the in-app counters are built around.

trophies.guide: This one awards itself: the platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are in, so never chase it directly. Play the story first while sweeping anything cheap nearby, keep rotating manual saves before finales and choice points, then use the post-story free roam to grind counts, collectibles and the 100 percent checklist. When the last bronze falls, the platinum follows immediately.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces Jason, Lucia and the Leonida Keys. It cannot be missed: simply play through the prologue at whatever pace you like, learning the driving, boating and cover basics as you go. Because it is the first trophy almost everyone earns, its launch rarity sits far above the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 to earn this. The chapter closes out the prologue arc and opens the mainland map, so push through its missions in order and let the cutscenes play. Nothing in the chapter is missable or skill-gated; if a firefight stalls you, drop back to cover, let Combat Focus recharge and flank instead of trading shots in the open.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The story widens across Vice City in this chapter, introducing the crew's money-making operations and the partner-switching missions. Play the markers in order, stock up on armour and snacks before each job, and bank your cash between missions so a bust or a hospital visit never costs you progress toward the money trophies later.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now both protagonists are playable and most side activities have unlocked, so it is worth detouring: try each new activity type once for Master of None and photograph vehicles as you steal them for Whip It Good. The chapter's final mission is a long one, so start it with full health, armour and ammo.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Missions grow longer and the wanted levels hotter, so keep a fast car garaged near each safehouse and learn the alley routes that break police line of sight. Save manually before the chapter finale: the choices and set pieces that follow feed directly into the missable trophies.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission to close the story and earn this gold. Go in prepared: maxed armour, a full weapon wheel, snacks and a repaired getaway car staged outside. The finale chains driving, shooting and a partner sequence with checkpoints between phases, so if one section keeps failing, lower your aggression and let your partner draw fire while you reposition.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, an early story mission built around a timed drive and a handoff that goes sideways. Follow the GPS route rather than shortcuts until you know the traffic patterns, keep the vehicle intact, and use the final stretch to practise shaking a two-star wanted level, a skill the partner trophies later demand at four stars.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, the first full heist of the story. Preparation matters: scout the approach, pick the crew the mission offers carefully and keep everyone alive for the cleanest payout. During the escape, switch drivers when the heat spikes and avoid the main highways, where roadblocks form fastest, until the wanted level starts to blink.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a story mission that mixes stealth with a short escort section. Move slowly, stay out of lit areas and let patrols pass before crossing open ground; being spotted rarely fails the mission outright, but it turns the escort chaotic. The same patience pays off later in Sneakthief, so treat this as quiet training.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a loud mid-story mission built around a public event and a running gunfight. Bring a rifle with a scope for the rooftop sections and keep moving between cover points as the crowd scatters. Enemies arrive in waves from marked entrances, so watch the minimap edges and reload during the lulls rather than mid-exchange.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport operation. This mission matters twice: finishing it earns this trophy, and its finale holds the only window for the missable Catch Me If You Can, so make a manual save before you start it. Clear the hangar methodically, keep a vehicle close for the runway sequence, and do not rush the ending.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a set-piece mission away from the city streets. Weather and visibility are the real enemies here: slow down, use headlights and cover, and let your partner call out targets. Stock up before the mission starts, because shops are scarce in the area, and keep Combat Focus in reserve for the final ambush.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100 percent completion, tracked by the in-game checklist under Progress, Stats, then 100% Completion. You do not need every collectible in Leonida, only the checklist's required share of missions, activities, collectibles and feats. Finish the story first, then work the checklist category by category with this tracker beside it; the last few percent are usually collectible sweeps.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and repeats on different ramps keep it varied. Work region by region with the in-game map, using a fast bike for jumps and a small plane for the bridge runs. The tracker counter mirrors the game's own tally, so log each session's stunts as you land them.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, challenges and stunt events unlock as the story opens the map. Nothing needs to be won, only started and finished once, so sample each as it appears. The counter lists the nine types; tick them off and the trophy lands with the ninth.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range scores accuracy, time and target streaks, so learn one weapon class at a time and replay until the gold pace feels routine. Start with pistols, save rifles for last, and use Combat Focus sparingly where the rules allow it. The counter tracks golds only, not attempts.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Winning, not just finishing, is required, so learn each course's racing line in a practice run, then attack the clock: cut gates close, boost on straights and never brake for the final chicane. Beach and downtown courses are the tightest; save them for when the drone feels natural.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same event do not add to the tally. Mix street, off-road, boat and air races as they unlock, and bring a tuned vehicle in its class rather than the fastest car you own. The counter counts distinct events won, so spread across the map instead of farming one easy circuit.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Accept his challenge at the marina, then match his pace: cast to the marked water, work the lure steadily and play big fish patiently instead of forcing the reel, which snaps the line. Upgrade your rod when the shop allows it and fish at dawn, when his target scores are at their softest.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade cabinet in Leonida. Pick the shortest cabinet first, a single race or a fixed set of levels, and see the credits or the final results screen; quitting mid-game does not count. It is one of the cheapest trophies on the list, so grab it during your first free-roam session.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, closing his stranger strand. His missions unlock in sequence as the story progresses, and the finale only appears after his earlier jobs are done, so check your messages and the map for his marker whenever a chapter ends. The finale is a driving-heavy send-off; bring a durable car and a full tank.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand runs through the marinas and the Keys, and its finale is a boat job: expect a chase on open water, so practise trimming speed through turns rather than holding full throttle into them. Finish his earlier missions as they appear, because the finale waits on all of them being closed out.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, the biker contact whose strand threads through the rural north of Leonida. His finale is a ride-and-fight job; a motorcycle is provided, but your own upgraded bike makes the chase sections calmer. Keep his earlier missions current as you pass through the area so the finale is ready when you are.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each anchor a strand, and more appear as the map opens. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish what you start instead of sampling every marker. The counter tracks completed strands; five of them also carry their own trophies.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, whose strand is built on moving product across the state. The finale is a long delivery under pressure: plan the route before you set off, avoid the interstates where patrols cluster, and swap vehicles if the heat passes three stars. His earlier jobs escalate gently, so finish them in order as training.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His strand leans on street racing and car culture, and the finale puts you in a feature race with a twist midway. Bring a car you know well rather than a new purchase, learn the first half of the route in free roam, and keep nitrous for the final straight.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida, from Ocean Beach rooftops to Keys overlooks. Each spot asks for a short, calm interaction rather than a challenge, so the real work is the travel: sweep them region by region after the story, and start early, because the first spot sits in an area the opening chapter leaves behind.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. His strand builds to a single named beast in the wetlands: track it at dawn, approach downwind and crouched, and bring a scoped rifle so the first shot counts. Spooking it is not failure; it circles back to its territory, so mark the area and return rather than chasing it across the swamp.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three Collectible Card sets. Cards hide on rooftops, in arcades, behind counters and across the Keys, and each set finishes when its last card is pocketed. You do not need every card in Leonida, only three full sets, so pick the sets whose cards cluster in areas you already sweep for other collectibles and track them together.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: the in-game app flags photo spots across the state, and each completed spot adds to the tally. This is a sweep, not a challenge, so pair it with the meditation spots and card hunts in the same regions. The counter steps in fives; expect the last locations to be scattered across the Keys.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the activities menu: short scored tasks covering driving, shooting, flying and footwork. Most take under two minutes and failing one costs nothing but the retry. Work them in batches whenever you pass a marker, and leave the precision driving set for last, when your garage and handling skills are at their best.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. Build the stars together in one vehicle, robberies or a rampage both work, then break line of sight: swap cars in a parking structure, hold still out of sight and let the search cones pass. Splitting up voids the spirit of it, so stay together throughout.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level between them. Plan a triangle of stores on one street, park facing the exit, and keep the run under a few minutes so the stars never fully drop. Your partner holds the door while you empty the register; the counter tracks the streak, and a lost wanted level resets it.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: entering a model you have never driven registers it. Steal broadly rather than deeply: parking lots, marinas, airports and rich neighbourhoods each stock models the others lack. The counter steps in fives, and the in-game stats page mirrors the same tally, so a weekly check there tells you which vehicle classes are still missing.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up rather than hoping for it: start a gang operation or a police standoff, let five targets gather in one sightline, then trigger Focus and drop them in one sweep, nearest first. A full Focus meter and a weapon with a large magazine make the window comfortable.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the international airport, during the VCIA Takedown story mission. When the mission reaches the airfield, ignore the scripted exit: break for a parked aircraft or service vehicle and leave the area your own way before the mission funnels you out. Save manually before starting VCIA Takedown so a clean run can be reloaded and retried.
trophies.missableReason: The departure window exists only inside the VCIA Takedown story mission. Finish that mission the standard way and the airport sequence is over for the playthrough — the game has no mission replay, so the moment cannot be recovered without reloading a save from before the mission.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke with teeth: survive an encounter with Rhinos, the army's tanks, and come out on top. Draw military attention at the base or during a five-star escape, then fight from cover with explosives: sticky charges on the hull, a grenade launcher from rooftops, anything but a fair fight in the open. Stealing one works too.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first: note the guard's patrol and the camera sweep, enter from the rear where your partner can hold the door, and take the display cases in one quiet pass. No alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level at any point; if a camera catches you, leave and reset rather than improvising.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of free-roam crime: bring your partner, a drilled escape route and a getaway car that is not registered to you. Rotate banks across the state so patrol patterns stay cold, and let your wanted level die completely between jobs; the counter only credits clean escapes.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run fixed routes between banks; ambush one where the road narrows, use a heavy vehicle to pin it, and crack the rear doors with explosives or sustained fire. The guards are armoured, so aim for the moments they reload. Once the cash is out, change vehicles twice before you hide.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: every named region, island and district must be visited at least once. Most reveal themselves through the story and side work, but a handful of Keys islets and swamp pockets sit off every route. After the credits, compare your map against the region list and sweep the grey patches by boat and light aircraft.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Every gang runs a front, a stash house, a chop shop or a dock, and hitting one marks that gang off. Spread the jobs out: robbing two operations of the same gang adds heat, not progress. The counter tracks distinct gangs, and your stats page names the ones remaining.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachfront bar on the Ocean Beach strip, order at the counter and take the drink as the light turns; it is a small, quiet interaction rather than a mission. It sits minutes from the prologue's route, so grab it during your first free roam and enjoy the postcard.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal a car inside the downtown showroom and drive it straight out through the glass frontage rather than the door. Any of the display cars will do, but the heavy coupe makes the cleanest exit. Expect instant police attention, so plan the first two turns before you start the engine.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: play a game at the alley and finish your frames properly, with a real follow-through on the final throw. The alley is a working activity venue, so this pairs naturally with Master of None. Visit with your partner for the full scene; a half-finished game abandoned mid-way does not count.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description hides this behind a joke, 'a partnership with mass appeal': it is earned in a one-off partner story beat where Jason and Lucia's relationship becomes public. When the story offers the moment, take it rather than rushing past, and keep a manual save before each late chapter finale so the beat can be revisited if it slips by.
trophies.missableReason: It hangs on a single partner story beat late in the campaign. Once the chapter containing that beat is finished, the moment is gone for the playthrough — the game has no mission replay — so keep a manual save before each late chapter finale.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: the game quietly counts the dialogue and story choices you make, and PSNProfiles' tracking puts the target at 500. Most come naturally from missions, stranger strands and partner conversations, so never skip a conversation you could play. The counter mirrors the hidden tally; if it stalls, work unfinished strands, where choices cluster.
trophies.missableReason: A share of the counted choices occur once, inside story missions and finales. A playthrough that has already passed those missions cannot recover their choices — the game has no mission replay — so play every conversation the story offers instead of skipping through it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: this is earned by failing at a one-attempt story moment and then succeeding on the retry it offers. Do not reload a manual save when a scripted attempt goes wrong; let the failure stand, take the second chance the game hands you, and finish it. The trophy lands on the successful retry, not the first attempt.
trophies.missableReason: The fail-then-succeed setup exists once in the story. Succeeding cleanly on the first attempt — or reloading a save to erase the failure — closes the setup for that playthrough, because the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This one covers Leonida's strangest random event: something unexplained that a small number of players stumble into in the rural dark. Spend time in the swamps and farmland at night, follow odd lights and sounds rather than the road, and when it happens, stay and watch it play out instead of driving away.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian-sized target with a melee swing as you pass, the driver's-side window down and your timing late rather than early. Practise on the bowling alley's street, where the name suggests, at moderate speed: too fast and the swing whiffs, too slow and it never registers as a drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from vault jobs, armored trucks and gang operations; bank them through the laundering contacts rather than spending them raw, and only laundered money counts. The counter steps in $5,000 lots. This pairs with Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control, so run all three grinds in the same circuit.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops: clothes, weapons, vehicle mods, boats and services all count, and nothing needs to be spent in one place. Play naturally and it lands mid-story for most players; if you are hoarding cash for properties, remember this counter only moves when money leaves your pocket, so outfit both protagonists properly instead of saving everything.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties across Leonida. Garages unlock for purchase as the map opens, and their prices climb with size and location, so this is a money trophy in disguise: heists, laundering and race winnings feed it. Buy the cheap rural garages first, and keep the counter honest by logging each purchase as the keys change hands.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: park a vehicle you own or have just acquired, open the app and complete its registration photo and plate check. Stolen cars must be made yours first, so pair this with Whip It Good: every new model you discover can be registered on the spot before you dump it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
